claims.claim: Sendbird publishes no OpenAPI document; the contract is deterministically reconstructed from the pinned official generated SDK
claims.summary: The official generated SDK repository is an openapi-generator artifact that is the machine-readable representation of the Platform API v3 wire contract; the metadata product reconstructs its OpenAPI 3.1 surface from it deterministically.
The official SDK base server configuration declares the Platform API server URL template https://api-{app_id}.sendbird.com with an app_id variable.

claims.claim: The generated SDK attaches the Application API Token as the `api-token` request header.
claims.summary: The official generated SDK request methods set the api-token request header from the caller-provided Application API Token.

claims.claim: The official generated SDK TypeScript package.json declares the Unlicense license.
claims.summary: The official generated SDK package.json declares the Unlicense license for the SDK source, which is the interface contract the reconstruction is derived from.

claims.claim: Pontx Hub does not proxy, cache, or aggregate Sendbird application data.
claims.summary: The product provenance records riskReview.hubProxyEnabled=false and every endpoint disables Hub execution, so the local SDK/CLI connects directly with the caller's own credentials.

claims.claim: a single user can join up to 2,000 group channels
claims.summary: The official SDK group-channel API documentation states that a single user can join up to 2,000 group channels and a user at capacity cannot join new channels.

claims.claim: DAU/MAU metrics update on a fixed 30-minute cadence
claims.summary: The official SDK statistics API documentation states the daily and monthly active user metrics are scheduled to be calculated every 30 minutes starting at 00:00 UTC.

claims.claim: the message migration feature is turned on through Sendbird support
claims.summary: The official SDK message API documentation states the migration feature must be turned on by contacting the Sendbird support team, and that users and a target channel must be registered first.
